data.description: Dubai Harbour is one of the most sought-after waterfront locations in Dubai offering a premier lifestyle experience

data.answer: The Dubai Harbour community presents an unparalleled blend of luxury and convenience across its expansive 20 million square feet. Developed by Meraas Holding, this waterfront destination stands at the crossroads of Palm Jumeirah and Bluewaters Island, situated along King Salman bin Abdulaziz Al Saud Street, also known as Mina Al Seyahi.

The residential island offers a diverse selection of apartments complemented by luxurious amenities and breathtaking vistas.

Within Dubai Harbour lies the esteemed residential development, EMAAR Beachfront by Emaar, an enclave synonymous with exclusivity. Situated near Dubai Marina, Downtown Dubai, Dubai International Airport, and the Expo 2020 site, this development promises residents unparalleled convenience. Boasting a pristine 1.5km beachfront, EMAAR Beachfront comprises 10,000 residential units spread across 27 towers, alongside a sprawling 13,000 sq. m. retail mall. Anticipated as one of Emaar's most eagerly awaited off-plan projects in Dubai, EMAAR Beachfront offers a diverse array of residential unit types, ranging from 1 to 4-bedroom apartments, luxurious 4-bedroom penthouses, and spacious 3 to 5-bedroom villas. These units are housed within prestigious towers such as Sunrise Bay, Grand Bleu Tower, Marina Vista, South Beach, and Beach Isle.

The apartments within Dubai Harbour promise generous living spaces adorned with modern finishes and flooded with natural light through floor-to-ceiling windows. Featuring spacious bedrooms, built-in wardrobes, attached bathrooms, fitted kitchens, and expansive balconies, these residences epitomize contemporary luxury.

Meanwhile, the 4-bedroom penthouses in Dubai Harbour offer a lavish living experience, comprising four capacious bedrooms with ensuite bathrooms, an open-plan kitchen, and a commodious living and dining area seamlessly connected to a balcony, inviting residents to indulge in panoramic views.

As for the villas nestled within Grand Bleu Tower and Beach Isle, they offer an unparalleled blend of space, style, and comfort. Available in configurations of 3 to 5 bedrooms, these modern villas boast spacious interiors, complemented by gardens and covered parking for two vehicles. Other noteworthy features include generously sized living areas, dining spaces, well-equipped kitchens, laundry rooms, maid's quarters, guest rooms with ensuite bathrooms, and ample storage facilities, ensuring a lifestyle of utmost convenience and luxury.

Off Plan Properties in Dubai Harbour

Dubai Harbour Residences
Discover the luxury of Dubai Harbour Residences, a stunning collection of beachfront homes designed by the acclaimed Nikken Sekkei. This project, developed by H&H Development and Shamal Holding, offers a selection of 1, 2, 3, and 4-bedroom apartments, providing an unparalleled living experience.

Sobha Seahaven by Sobha Realty

Sobha Seahaven offers an exquisite lifestyle where you can wake up to the tranquil sounds of the waves and reconnect with the blue oceans. Located in Dubai Harbour, these 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments provide incredible views and a serene escape from the city.

Damac Bay 2 by Damac Properties
Damac Bay by Cavalli is a stunning oceanfront property created for individuals seeking the ultimate lifestyle experience. Located in Dubai Harbour, these luxurious residences include one, two, three, four, and five-bedroom apartments. Completion is expected in 2028.

Rent Trends In Dubai Harbour

You can find various properties for rent in Dubai Harbour from stylish apartments to luxurious penthouses. These properties offer various facilities to residents, including breathtaking beach views.

Sale Trends In Dubai Harbour

Apartments for sale in Dubai Harbour are perfect for those seeking luxurious properties in Dubai. This freehold area offers a variety of apartments, all characterized by their premium waterfront living experience, which comes with a significant price tag.

The price range for apartments for sale in Dubai Harbour starts from AED 1.05M. Specifically, 1-bedroom apartments start from AED 1.05M, while 2-bedroom flats are priced at AED 1.58M.

For those interested in a 3-bedroom apartment, prices stars from AED 2.9M. A 4-bedroom apartment can be purchased for a minimum price of AED 5.5M. Similarly, a 4-bedroom penthouse in Dubai Harbour is priced at AED 5.4M.

more_info.question: What’s Life Like in Dubai Harbour?

data.answer:
Life in the Dubai Harbour community is characterized by luxury, convenience, and stunning coastal views. Residents enjoy access to world-class amenities, including a sprawling marina, pristine beaches, upscale retail and dining options, and an exclusive yacht club. The area is well-connected, offering seamless access to key areas such as Dubai Marina, Downtown Dubai, and the airport. With modern, spacious residences and a vibrant, waterfront lifestyle, Dubai Harbour provides an unparalleled living experience.

Public Transportation in Dubai Harbour Dubai

To utilize public transportation in Dubai Harbour, individuals depend on the bus services available in the vicinity. The closest bus stops comprise Jumeira, Royal Meridian 1, Jumeira, Royal Meridian 2, Media City Tram Station 1, and Media City Tram Station 2, all reachable within a short 5 to 10-minute drive from Dubai Harbour. Alternatively, those opting for metro travel can reach the Dubai Internet City Metro Station and Sobha Realty Metro Station, both situated approximately 13 minutes away by car.

Supermarkets in Dubai Harbour

Supermarkets in Dubai Harbour cater to residents' daily needs with a diverse range of options conveniently located within the vicinity. Popular choices include Spinneys and Carrefour, providing a wide selection of fresh produce, groceries, household essentials, and gourmet items. These supermarkets offer a seamless shopping experience, ensuring that residents have easy access to quality products for their everyday requirements. With their strategic locations and comprehensive offerings, Spinneys and Carrefour serve as vital hubs for shopping convenience within the vibrant Dubai Harbour community.

Shopping Malls Near Dubai Harbour

Near Dubai Harbour, several shopping malls offer a diverse array of retail and entertainment options, all within a short driving distance. One notable destination is the Marina Mall, situated just a 10-minute drive away. This expansive shopping center features a wide range of international brands, dining establishments, and entertainment facilities, providing a comprehensive shopping experience.

Additionally, residents can explore The Beach Mall, located approximately 15 minutes from Dubai Harbour by car. This beachfront shopping destination offers a unique blend of retail outlets, restaurants, and leisure activities, all set against the backdrop of the stunning JBR Beach. Both Marina Mall and The Beach Mall offer convenient access to residents of Dubai Harbour, ensuring they have access to a diverse range of shopping experiences nearby.

Nurseries and Schools in and Near Dubai Harbour

Within and near Dubai Harbour, families have access to a variety of nurseries and schools catering to the educational needs of children. One prominent option within the community is the Dubai British School, offering a British curriculum and world-class facilities to students from nursery through secondary levels. Gems Wellington Schools is also an excellent option for the residents. 
Additionally, The Arbor School, located nearby, provides an eco-friendly learning environment with a focus on sustainability and innovation. For younger children, nurseries like Blossom Burj Nursery and Kids World Nursery offer quality early childhood education programs.

Families residing in Dubai Harbour also have access to renowned educational institutions in surrounding areas, such as the Dubai British International School in Dubai Marina and the American School of Dubai in nearby Al Barsha. These schools provide diverse curricula and extracurricular activities, ensuring families have access to excellent educational options within a reasonable distance from Dubai Harbour.

Churches, Temples, and Mosques in and near The Dubai Harbour Dubai

Notable churches nearby include the Emirates Baptist Church International and the Holy Trinity Church, both located within a reasonable distance from Dubai Harbour. Additionally, for individuals of Hindu faith, the Shiva Temple and the Gurudwara Temple offer spiritual sanctuaries within the vicinity. Furthermore, mosques such as the Masjid Al Rahim and the Masjid Al Marwan provide places of worship for Muslim residents and visitors.

Clinics and Hospitals In Dubai Harbour

Among the prominent clinics is the Dubai Harbour Medical Clinic, which offers a range of services including general medicine, pediatrics, dermatology, gynecology, and minor surgeries. The clinic is known for its modern facilities, experienced doctors, and the convenience of online appointment booking.

Another notable clinic is the Harbour Health Clinic, which provides family medicine, dental services, physiotherapy, and wellness programs. Additionally, the Dubai Marina Medical Centre offers comprehensive healthcare services, including cardiology, orthopedics, and internal medicine. It stands out as a multi-specialty clinic with an in-house pharmacy and emergency services, making it a reliable option for immediate medical attention.

For more extensive medical needs, Al Zahra Hospital is located near Dubai Marina, approximately 10 minutes from Dubai Harbour. It is a full-fledged hospital offering a wide range of services, including emergency care, surgery, maternity, and intensive care.

Dubai Harbour Location & Nearby Areas

Dubai Marina, just a 5-minute drive away, is renowned for its residential skyscrapers, dining options, shopping venues, and a picturesque waterfront promenade. Jumeirah Beach Residence (JBR), located around 10 minutes by car, offers a beachfront lifestyle with a plethora of outdoor activities, numerous restaurants, cafes, and vibrant nightlife.

Palm Jumeirah, about 15 minutes from Dubai Harbour, is synonymous with luxury, featuring high-end villas, apartments, world-class resorts, fine dining, and leisure activities. Similarly, Bluewaters Island, approximately 10 minutes away, is home to Ain Dubai, the world's largest observation wheel, and boasts upscale residential, retail, hospitality, and entertainment zones.

Al Sufouh, around 15 minutes by car, is a residential community known for its high-end villas and close proximity to educational institutions and business hubs. Lastly, Business Bay, about 20 minutes from Dubai Harbour, is a commercial and residential area with access to the Dubai Canal, business offices, dining, and shopping options.

more_info.question: Things To Do in Dubai Harbour

data.answer:
Dubai Harbour is a vibrant destination offering a variety of activities for residents and visitors alike. You can start your day with a luxury yacht tour, exploring the stunning coastline and iconic landmarks like the Palm Jumeirah and Burj Al Arab. For those interested in maritime activities, Dubai Harbour Marina is perfect for sailing and water sports.

The area also features Dubai Harbour Yacht Club, where you can enjoy exclusive events and networking opportunities. Additionally, the Harbour's bustling promenade is ideal for leisurely walks, jogging, or cycling while enjoying breathtaking views of the Arabian Gulf. Shopping enthusiasts can explore the nearby upscale boutiques and designer stores, making Dubai Harbour a perfect blend of relaxation and entertainment.

Dubai Harbour Restaurants & Bars

Dubai Harbour boasts a diverse selection of restaurants and bars, offering a wide range of culinary experiences. For fine dining, you can visit "Pier 7" in Dubai Marina, just a 5-minute drive away, featuring seven different cuisines in a single tower with stunning waterfront views. For a more casual restaurant near Dubai Harbour, "The Scene by Simon Rimmer" is a good option. It offers British cuisine with a contemporary twist and is also located in Pier 7. Barasti Bar in Restaurants is also a popular option nearby.

If you're looking for a vibrant nightlife scene, "Zero Gravity" beach club, located about 10 minutes away, provides an exciting atmosphere with international DJs, a beachside bar, and a restaurant. Additionally, the "Dubai Marina Yacht Club" offers elegant dining options with picturesque marina views, making it a great spot for a romantic dinner or a night out with friends.

Beaches Near Dubai Harbour

Dubai Harbour is conveniently located near some of the best beaches in Dubai. The closest is JBR Beach, just a 10-minute drive away, which offers a lively atmosphere with a range of water sports, dining options, and a beautiful sandy shoreline.

Another great option is Kite Beach, located about 20 minutes from Dubai Harbour, known for its vibrant scene of kite surfers, paddleboarders, and food trucks. For a more tranquil experience, Sunset Beach is around 15 minutes away and provides stunning views of the Burj Al Arab, perfect for a relaxing day by the sea or a picturesque sunset. These nearby beaches offer something for everyone, whether you're looking for adventure or a peaceful retreat.

Hotels Near Dubai Harbour

Dubai Harbour is surrounded by a variety of luxurious hotels offering top-notch amenities and stunning views. The area houses the Dubai Marriott Harbour Hotel and Suites. The Address Dubai Marina, just a 5-minute drive away, provides elegant rooms, an infinity pool, and direct access to Dubai Marina Mall. Another excellent option is the Grosvenor House, located about 7 minutes from Dubai Harbour, known for its sophisticated style and world-class dining options. For those seeking a beachfront experience, the Ritz-Carlton Dubai in JBR is approximately 10 minutes away, offering private beach access and luxurious spa services. Each of these hotels ensures a comfortable and memorable stay close to Dubai Harbour. Another excellent tourist attraction, SkyDive Dubai, is about 6 minutes from the area.

Attractions and Landmarks Near Dubai Harbour

Dubai Harbour's prime location places it near several renowned attractions and landmarks. The iconic Palm Jumeirah, with its luxurious resorts and the Atlantis Aquaventure Waterpark, is just a 15-minute drive away. The vibrant Dubai Marina Walk, featuring a variety of dining and entertainment options, is only 5 minutes away. Bluewaters Island, home to Ain Dubai, the world's largest observation wheel, is about a 10-minute drive from Dubai Harbour. Additionally, the stunning Burj Al Arab, one of the most famous landmarks in Dubai, is approximately 20 minutes away, offering a glimpse into the city's luxurious lifestyle.

Outdoor Activities, Gyms and Salons

Dubai Harbour offers a plethora of outdoor activities, gyms, and salons for a well-rounded lifestyle. The Dubai Marina Promenade, just a 5-minute drive away, is perfect for jogging, cycling, or a leisurely walk by the waterfront. For fitness enthusiasts, the Fitness First in Dubai Marina is also about 5 minutes away, providing state-of-the-art equipment and a variety of classes. If you prefer outdoor fitness, the nearby Kite Beach, 20 minutes away, offers paddleboarding, beach volleyball, and kitesurfing. For relaxation and grooming, the renowned Sisters Beauty Lounge in JBR, around 10 minutes from Dubai Harbour, offers a range of beauty treatments and salon services, ensuring you stay refreshed and pampered.

One thing to consider about living in Dubai Harbour is the high cost of living. The luxurious lifestyle, waterfront properties, and premium amenities come with a hefty price tag, which might not be suitable for everyone’s budget. This can be a limiting factor for those looking for more affordable living options in Dubai.

What types of properties are available in Dubai Harbour?

Dubai Harbour offers a range of luxurious properties, including apartments, penthouses, and waterfront villas. These properties are known for their modern designs, premium finishes, and stunning views of the Arabian Gulf.

Is Dubai Harbour a good location for families?

Yes, Dubai Harbour is an excellent location for families. It provides a safe and secure environment, with access to top-notch schools, healthcare facilities, recreational areas, and family-friendly attractions.

What amenities are available in Dubai Harbour?

Dubai Harbour boasts a wide array of amenities, including luxury hotels, fine dining restaurants, high-end retail stores, marinas, yacht clubs, fitness centers, and beautiful promenades for walking and cycling.

How is the transportation connectivity in Dubai Harbour?

Dubai Harbour is well-connected to the rest of the city through major road networks. It is easily accessible by car, and there are plans for improved public transportation options, including metro and bus services, to enhance connectivity further.

data.content:
Dubai Harbour, an expansive waterfront project overseen by Meraas Holding, sprawls across 20 million square feet at the convergence of Palm Jumeirah and Bluewaters Island, situated off King Salman bin Abdulaziz Al Saud Street, also recognized as Mina Al Seyahi. This prestigious development promises luxury and leisure in its prime location.

At the heart of Dubai Harbour lies its impressive marina, set to be the largest in the MENA region, boasting 1,100 berths capable of accommodating even the grandest private yachts. The marina complex offers an array of amenities, including a sailing club, helipad facilities, and essential services like Grey and Black Water Service, fuel stations, and crew accommodations, establishing it as a comprehensive yachting hub.

Moreover, the project includes two state-of-the-art cruise terminals spanning over 120,000 square feet each, designed to handle the seamless turnaround of two cruise ships simultaneously. These terminals aren't just functional; they're designed to offer a luxurious experience, with leisure, retail, and entertainment options. Complementing these facilities is an intricate transportation network linking the cruise terminals, yacht clubs, hotels, and the airport, ensuring seamless connectivity for visitors and residents alike.
